description: garrett, the agent of sentinels: a host intrusion sentinel that stops what it catches. It runs as SYSTEM, so install it from a PowerShell opened with Run as administrator.
notes: garrett is running as SYSTEM, starts with Windows, and keeps itself up to date. See what it finds:

script: # The bundle's installer copies garrett to C:\Program Files\garrett, locks it, and starts it as SYSTEM. It runs in
# a PowerShell of its own: it sets its own PATH, which must not become the PATH of the shell Scoop runs in.
# Scoop runs this before every update as well ($cmd is then 'update'): garrett, its cases and its enrolment
# stay on the machine through an update, and only leave it on scoop uninstall.
